bifrost: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev decoding, pointer and touch only); springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs (device vibrator check for Keyboard Haptics); springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Bluetooth adapter, not a game controller profile); no app-facing SDK module for controllers
summary: BifrOSt has no game controller API. Its evdev layer decodes touch, pointer, keyboard and key events and nothing else, so an app cannot discover a gamepad, read its buttons or sticks, or drive its haptics. The framework's keyboard and mouse profiles map loosely to the input layer that exists, but no app receives them through an SDK API.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/gamepad.rs (Capabilities::is_game_controller, Registry::connected, Registry::disconnected); wired: springboard/src/shell/services/gamepad_service.rs (views, snapshot); springboard/src/shell/game_controllers_page.rs (list page); springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-18.rs
features.note: Headless tests in parity_sdk-tests-18 cover the controller test, id assignment, connect and disconnect events and rumble detection. The shell's gamepad service keeps a Registry and the controllers page lists the pads. Gap: apps receive no connect or disconnect event, and the hot-plug path is not yet verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: SDK bifrost_app::gamepad_input re-exports the registry and its Connected and Disconnected events, and describe_connection gives their one-line text; tests gamepad_input::tests. Wave 4 (2026-10-17): the shell sends connected and disconnected service events to every app, and bifrost_app::gamepad_input::Session tracks the pads from them; tests gamepad_input::tests.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/gamepad.rs (ControllerInput); springboard/sdk/src/gamepad_input.rs (describe, button_name, axis_name); wired: springboard/src/shell/services/gamepad_service.rs (tick, remap_change)
features.note: The model maps 13 buttons, two sticks with clicks, two triggers and the direction pad, with dead zones, change callbacks, a polling queue and a plain-text description per change; the SDK exposes it as bifrost_app::gamepad_input (headless tests in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-34.rs). Needs hardware: no real controller has been read on Midget, and the shell's event decoder still treats the stick axes as a pointer until the event loop feeds this model (see ui/src/gamepad.rs). Built 2026-10-17: SDK ExtendedProfile (bifrost_app::gamepad_input) copies one pad's state with named sticks, triggers, direction pad and buttons; tests gamepad_input::tests. Wave 4 (2026-10-17): the shell's input events reach the focused app, and Session pushes each one onto its controller's ControllerInput (Gamepad::apply, ControllerInput::push); tests gamepad_input::tests and ui gamepad::tests.

features.feature: Button, axis, switch and direction-pad elements
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/gamepad.rs (element, Gamepad::feed, ControllerInput); wired: springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs (gamepad_slide, gamepad_new_game) fed by springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/system.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/game_controllers_page.rs (Remap, controller_spec, live_rows); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-18.rs
features.note: Headless tests in parity_sdk-tests-18 cover the Linux gamepad codes mapped to buttons, sticks, triggers and the direction pad, button edges, dead zones and the queued change stream. Gap: switch elements are not modelled, and apps receive mapped actions rather than raw elements. The shell's controllers page uses the model; verify on Midget for parity. Built 2026-10-17: ExtendedProfile exposes the buttons, both sticks, triggers and the direction pad by name; tests gamepad_input::tests. Switch elements still not modelled.

features.feature: Keyboard and mouse as game input
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/game_input.rs (KeyboardProfile, MouseProfile); springboard/src/shell/hwkeys.rs (hardware-keyboard shortcuts, read separately by the shell)
features.note: KeyboardProfile and MouseProfile turn evdev key and relative records into edges, a held set, per-frame motion and wheel steps, with release on focus loss; headless tests in ui/tests/parity_sdk-rest-09.rs. Gap: the shell's event loop does not feed these models and the SDK has no app-facing profile yet; checking a real keyboard and mouse needs the lab machine.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 2 (theme-27, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The vibrator check serves the keyboard feedback setting only. No rumble or haptic-locality API exists for controllers or apps.

Headless tests in parity_sdk-tests-18 cover battery levels and states, colour clamping and the light's stored colour. The shell reads each pad's battery and shows it on the controllers page. Gap: no light is written to a pad, and no light query exists.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-game-controller, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No motion or orientation input is read from controllers or from the device.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-game-controller, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The touch layer could feed a virtual pad, but no SDK virtual controller exists.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-game-controller, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No force-feedback or wheel input model exists.

features.apple: Not part of Game Controller (web Gamepad API)
features.note: snapshot lays a controller's state out in the web standard mapping (17 buttons, 4 axes) with slot and name checks, tested in ui/tests/parity_sdk-rest-09.rs. Gap: no code passes the snapshot to the browser engine, so page scripts still see no gamepads; confirm on Midget with a controller once the engine is wired.

gaps: No controller discovery or connection events for apps (GCController.controllers, controllerDidConnect).
No gamepad input model: no buttons, axes, triggers, hats or direction-pad elements in the evdev decoder (springboard/src/bare/input.rs).
No SDK input profile for apps (extended, micro or racing wheel profiles).
No haptics or rumble API for controllers (springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs only checks for a vibrator node).
No controller battery, light or motion data.
No virtual controller for touch-only devices.
No Home button or controller settings manager (GCControllerHomeButtonSettingsManager) and no controller pages in Settings (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs has no controller page).
Web Gamepad API status unverified (springboard/apps/browser/engine/Cargo.toml enables Servo's gamepad feature).
